02.title: Di P2P Global Vision
02.description: Why P2P dey: everybody dey learn from somebody, and dey help somebody grow — from one generation go the next.

units.u001: Every life of faith start with somebody wey care well-well to share am.
units.u002: One mama wey open the Bible with her pikin.
units.u003: One friend wey explain wetin grace really mean.
units.u004: One teacher wey stay back to answer one more question.
units.u005: Somebody share the truth with them.
units.u006: And now, dem dey share am with another person.
units.u007: Na so faith don dey move since: from one person go another, from one generation go the next.
units.u008: Paul tell Timothy make e hand wetin e receive over to faithful people, wey go fit teach other people too.
units.u009: One believer dey help another one grow.
units.u010: That believer go help another person.
units.u015: Until the knowledge of the glory of the Lord full the whole earth, like how water cover the sea.
units.u017: And everybody fit help somebody grow.
units.u018: This na the vision of P2P Global.

03.title: Welcome to P2P
03.description: First look round P2P: Home, Learning, the Bible, Messages and more — and how everything join together.

units.u001: Welcome to P2P Global, the Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network.
units.u002: P2P na place to learn God Word, understand am, live am, and help another person grow.
units.u003: Make we waka small round the app, so you go sabi where everything dey.
units.u005: Every day you go see Daily Word: one verse, with short instruction wey go help you put am for practice.
units.u006: You fit open the full chapter, listen to am, and see your growth stage one time.
units.u007: The Learning tab na where you go grow for understanding.
units.u008: Kingdom School go carry you pass the Core Foundations, one lesson at a time.
units.u009: Kingdom Stories dey open the history of the Bible.
units.u010: P2P Plans dey help you study one subject for your own pace, and Study Together go make you learn with other people.
units.u011: For the Bible tab, you fit read Scripture for plenty translations and languages.
units.u012: Listen with the audio player, highlight the verses wey touch you, compare translations side by side, and search the whole Bible.
units.u013: Messages dey keep your relationships close.
units.u014: Chat with the people wey you dey learn with, create private groups, and write longer letters with P2P Mail.
units.u015: Under More, you go see Prayer, with guided prayer paths, praying the Word, and prayer journal.
units.u016: You go also see Discover, where you fit connect with other believers, find your church, and check out missions.
units.u017: My Profile dey tell your story: your growth, your discipleship relationships, and your journey from Seed to Sprout, Young Tree, Fruitful Tree, and Forest Builder.
units.u018: Growth for here dey show real steps wey you don take.
units.u019: E no be measure of how much you worth for God eye.
units.u022: And remember: everybody dey learn from somebody, and dey help somebody grow.

overlays.p02s:
Open today word —
read am, listen to am,
put am for practice
overlays.l02: Start with today word.  Take your first lesson.
overlays.l03: Everybody dey learn from somebody, and dey help somebody grow.
overlays.outro2: Start with today word. Everybody dey learn from somebody.

04.title: Wetin Be Peer Guide?
04.description: Wetin peer guide be, why peer guidance dey, and how guide dey waka with person wey dey grow.

units.u001: Think of somebody wey you share Jesus with: one friend, one neighbour, somebody wey you meet only once.
units.u002: Now, dem don start to follow Am.
units.u003: Dem dey read Bible, but dem get questions, and dem no sure where to start.
units.u004: Nobody suppose grow for faith alone.
units.u005: Scripture talk say two better pass one.
units.u006: If one falls down, his companion can lift him up.
units.u008: Because faith dey grow well inside relationship.
units.u009: Jesus no just teach the crowd.
units.u010: E choose small group make dem dey with Am: E chop with them, answer their questions, and pray with them.
units.u011: And the early believers grow the same way, dey encourage one another every day.
units.u012: For P2P, Peer Guide na fellow believer wey dey one step ahead of you for the discipleship journey.
units.u013: E no be pastor or teacher, na just somebody wey don waka this road before you, and ready to waka with you now.
units.u014: Your Peer Guide go follow you do the lessons, answer your questions, look your reflections, and pray with you.
units.u015: See am like spiritual friend wey get small more experience.
units.u016: You fit ask for Peer Guide when you first join P2P.
units.u017: Write short greeting, and you fit start your journey sharp-sharp while dem dey find the correct person for you.
units.u018: Later, you fit always open Find a Peer Guide and look for match.
units.u019: Peer Guide no dey replace Christ, the Scriptures, your pastor, or the work of the Holy Spirit.
units.u020: Paul talk am simple: I planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
units.u021: Peer Guide na companion for the road.
units.u022: And one day, the person wey dem guide go turn guide.
units.u023: Wetin you receive, you go pass am on, to somebody wey dey one step behind you.
units.u024: Na so discipleship dey grow: from one life go another, and from one generation go the next.
units.u025: Everybody dey learn from somebody, and dey help somebody grow.
units.u027: And who you go waka with?

overlays.l02: Peer Guide na fellow believer wey dey one step ahead of you for the journey.
overlays.l05: Everybody dey learn from somebody, and dey help somebody grow.
overlays.l06: Who go waka with you?  And who you go waka with?
overlays.outro2: Who go waka with you — and who you go waka with?

05.title: Church Wey Dey Make Disciples
05.description: How P2P dey support church discipleship: to equip leaders, care for members, and send people go out.

units.u001: Before Jesus go back to heaven, E give His Church clear commission: go make disciples of all nations, and teach them to obey everything wey E command.
units.u002: Discipleship don always happen inside the life of the church.
units.u004: Through small groups wey gather round open Bible.
units.u006: And through friendship, where one believer dey help another one grow.
units.u007: Christ give pastors and teachers to equip His people for the work of ministry.
units.u008: But between Sundays, e fit hard to know who dey grow, who dey struggle, and wetin be each person next step.
units.u009: Dem build P2P Global to help local church make this work strong, no be to replace am.
units.u010: Church fit register for P2P completely free, invite members with code, and give them one place wey dem go dey learn and grow together.
units.u011: Inside the church space, leaders go see church chat, files and resources, gatherings, small groups, and announcements.
units.u012: Members fit follow the Kingdom School foundations and study together, each person dey keep him own progress.
units.u013: Church fit study the same Kingdom School lesson, or the same Kingdom Story, together.
units.u014: Small groups fit go through am for their own pace, while each member dey keep him own progress and him own reflections.
units.u015: As dem dey go, members dey do short comprehension checks, and write personal reflections for their discipleship journal, so that learning go turn understanding, and understanding go turn changed life.
units.u016: Community overview dey show how many people dey learn for real.
units.u017: E dey also gently show members wey don quiet for some time, and new believers wey never get guide, so that nobody go just slip comot.
units.u018: And because discipleship no dey end for church door, families fit create Family Circle to pray and learn together for house, while Peer Guides dey help newer believers waka with somebody wey dey one step ahead of them.
units.u019: P2P no dey take the place of your pastor, the gathered church, or the work of the Holy Spirit.
units.u020: Na tool to help congregation practise wetin Scripture don already describe: believers wey devote themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship, wey dey hand wetin dem receive over to faithful people wey go teach others too.
units.u021: Church wey dey make disciples dey raise people wey go make disciples, for their house, their workplace, and their community.
units.u022: Bring your church come P2P Global, make una grow together.

overlays.l03: Register your church — free, no subscription
overlays.l05.ref: Bring your church come P2P Global
overlays.outro2: Grow together. Make disciples wey go make disciples.

06.title: Di Bible and Deep Study
06.description: To read the Bible for your language, and study am deeper with tools wey go help you understand.

units.u001: Scripture na God word to us.
units.u002: The psalmist call am lamp for him leg, and light for him road.
units.u004: When the Bereans hear the message, dem receive am with plenty eagerness, and dem dey check the Scriptures every day.
units.u005: Dem design P2P to help you do the same: to read, to listen, to understand, and to live wetin you find.
units.u006: Open the Bible tab, and choose any book and chapter.
units.u007: Read am for plenty translations and languages, and switch between them anytime wey you like.
units.u008: When you prefer to listen, the audio player go read Scripture loud, so the Word fit follow you as you dey waka, dey work, or dey rest.
units.u009: Good way to start dey simple.
units.u011: Ask wetin e show you about God, about people, and about how to live.
units.u012: Then pray am back to God, and look for one way to obey am today.
units.u013: Select verse to highlight am, and keep am for your Bible library.
units.u014: Compare one verse for different translations side by side.
units.u015: And search the whole Bible for one word or one theme.
units.u016: When you wan go further, Bible Study dey open separate space for careful study.
units.u017: For Deep Study, you go see Biblical Dictionary, reference articles, commentaries, and word-study tools wey dey show wetin the original words mean.
units.u018: Deep Study no dey replace to read the Bible.
units.u019: Na to serve am e dey.
units.u020: You go read the text first, then study am well, so that understanding go lead to faith and obedience.
units.u021: All Scripture is God-breathed, and useful for instruction and for training in righteousness.
units.u026: Open the Bible for P2P today.

overlays.p01s:
Any book, any chapter,
plenty translations
overlays.l05: Read am.  Listen to am.  Study am.  And live am.
overlays.outro2: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

07.title: Learning for P2P
07.description: How learning dey work for P2P — lessons, stories, plans, studying together, reflection and growth.

units.u001: Learning for P2P no be to gather lessons.
units.u002: Na to grow for understanding, so that the truth go shape the way you dey live.
units.u003: Make we follow one learner, Grace, as her journey dey open.
units.u005: The Core Foundations dey lay strong foundation, one module at a time: e start with Peer-to-Peer Orientation, then the Gospel and salvation, and continue through the main things of Christian faith.
units.u006: When she ready to go further, electives dey offer plans and courses for plenty subjects.
units.u007: Each lesson dey open the Scriptures, explain them well, and end with questions wey go help her understand and apply wetin she read.
units.u008: Side by side with her lessons, Kingdom Stories dey open the people and events of the Bible, like Abraham, the man wey believe God promise, dem tell am chapter by chapter.
units.u009: As she dey go, short comprehension checks dey help her put wetin she learn for her own words.
units.u010: To write am down dey help the truth move from her head enter her heart.
units.u011: When she wan explore one subject, like love, P2P Plans fit help her build personal study plan, with Scripture, supporting readings, and schedule wey fit her life.
units.u012: Learning dey go deeper with other people.
units.u013: With Study Together, Grace fit invite friend, her Family Circle, or her church to study one Kingdom Story or one Kingdom School lesson together.
units.u014: Each person dey keep him own progress, and her reflections go stay private unless she choose to share them.
units.u015: Her Learning Centre dey gather everything for one place: the checks wey she still get to do, the work wey she don submit, and the feedback when e land.
units.u016: And for her Discipleship Journal, she dey write her reflections.
units.u018: Wetin dey hard for her to apply?
units.u020: As time dey go, dem dey record her growth with real evidence: lessons wey she understand, truth wey she apply, and people wey she help.
units.u021: Step by step, from Seed, go reach Forest Builder.
units.u022: And as she dey grow, she begin help other people: she dey invite friend to study with her, and one day, she go waka with somebody wey just dey start.
units.u023: Learning na the beginning, no be the destination.
units.u024: Scripture call us make we be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
units.u025: For P2P, everything wey you learn, na to live am, and pass am on.

overlays.l01: To grow for understanding, so that the truth go shape the way you dey live
overlays.l03: Learn the truth.  Live the truth.  Help another person grow.
overlays.outro2: Learn the truth. Live the truth. Help another person grow.

08.title: Discipleship Dey Start for House
08.description: Family discipleship and Family Circle: to learn, pray and grow together for house.

units.u001: Long before pikin sit down for classroom, or for church bench, e don dey learn for house.
units.u004: And as e dey ask questions.
units.u005: God tell His people make dem keep His words for their heart, and teach them well-well to their children: when dem sit for house, and when dem dey waka for road.
units.u006: Discipleship for house no dey usually loud.
units.u007: E be like papa or mama wey dey read Scripture for table.
units.u008: Family wey dey pray together before dem sleep.
units.u009: Grandparent wey dey tell how God dey faithful.
units.u010: And pikin question wey deserve patient answer.
units.u011: Timothy faith first live inside him grandmama Lois, and inside him mama Eunice.
units.u012: Faith dey often pass through ordinary family life, one day at a time.
units.u013: E also be like parents wey dey listen: wey dey make room for honest questions, and wey no fear to talk say, I no know.
units.u015: P2P Family Circle dey give your household one shared space for this.
units.u016: Create your circle, and invite your family.
units.u017: Start gathering for worship, Scripture, and prayer.
units.u018: Keep family chat with messages and voice notes.
units.u019: Share your family prayer requests, study together, and look back the gatherings wey una don share.
units.u020: Parents fit listen to their children.
units.u021: Children fit see faith wey dem dey live for their front.
units.u022: And the whole family fit grow, together.
units.u023: Discipleship no suppose stop for church door.
units.u025: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

09.title: Kingdom Stories
09.description: The people and events of the Bible, dem tell am chapter by chapter.

units.u001: Long time ago, God carry one man wey dem dey call Abraham go outside, and tell am make e look up for sky, and count the stars, if e fit.
units.u005: Dem carry one people go far away, and bring them back home again.
units.u006: And when the time reach well-well, God send His Son.
units.u008: The One wey every promise dey point to.
units.u009: His followers carry the message from Jerusalem go reach the end of the earth.
units.u010: The early Church gather, pray, suffer, and grow.
units.u011: This na the story of God wey dey work inside history.
units.u012: And everything wey dem write before, dem write am for our instruction, so that we go get hope.
units.u014: Collection wey dey grow, of the people and events of the Bible, and of the Church through the ages.
units.u015: Explore them chapter by chapter, for P2P Global.

overlays.l04.ref: Bible history · Jesus Christ · The early Church · Church history

10.title: Kingdom School
10.description: Bible learning wey get order, wey dey build strong foundation, one lesson at a time.

units.u001: Jesus talk say everybody wey hear His words, and do wetin dem talk, be like wise man wey build him house on top rock.
units.u002: Strong life dey build on top strong foundation.
units.u003: Kingdom School na P2P Global road wey get order, through the main things of Christian faith.
units.u004: Core Foundations start with Peer-to-Peer Orientation, and the Gospel and salvation, and continue step by step through more than one hundred and eighty lessons, and e still dey grow.
units.u005: Electives dey give plans and courses to go further.
units.u006: Each lesson dey open the Scriptures, explain them, and check your understanding, so that knowledge go turn conviction, and conviction go turn changed life.

overlays.l02: Learn with order.  Understand am deep.  Live am faithfully.
overlays.outro2: Kingdom School — for the Learning tab of P2P Global.

11.title: From Learning to Living
11.description: How wetin we learn dey shape everyday life, relationships, decisions and service.

units.u002: One verse, wey she read early for morning, before the day start to make noise.
units.u004: She open one study, and look wetin e mean well-well.
units.u005: And she ask: wetin this one show me about God?
units.u006: And wetin e dey ask from me?
units.u010: One small decision about how to live today.
units.u012: For house, she listen small longer.
units.u013: For work, she talk the truth, even when e for easy pass make she no talk am.
units.u014: For her community, she notice somebody wey need help, and she stop.
units.u015: For Sunday, she worship with her church, and listen to the Word wey dem preach.
units.u016: For her pikin school, she read with one child wey dey struggle.
units.u017: With one old friend, she choose to forgive.
units.u019: But each one na the Word, wey dem live.
units.u020: Scripture call us make we be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
units.u021: One friend ask her wetin don change.
units.u022: So she share wetin she don dey learn.
units.u023: Some weeks after, that friend open the same Scriptures, and begin to grow.
units.u024: So dem start to read together, once every week.
units.u028: And one day, that friend go do the same for another person.
units.u029: This na the heart of P2P Global.
units.u031: The truth wey we receive na to shape the way we dey live, and the way we dey help other people grow.

overlays.l03: The truth wey we receive na to shape the way we dey live.
overlays.l04: Learn the truth.  Live the truth.  Help another person grow.
overlays.outro2: Learn the truth. Live the truth. Help another person grow.
